person.name: Jeanine Emilia Cornillot
person.profileThroughline: Jeanine Cornillot works across three connected practices: creating and showrunning narrative series, writing from lived and cultural experience, and testing how practical AI can support creative production. Across each, the throughline is the same: turning complex material into clear, character-driven stories and useful new formats.

chapters.title: Productions
chapters.description: Selected podcast and television work across nonfiction, scripted fiction, culture, and documentary storytelling.

items.title: Scamfluencers
items.summary: A weekly true-crime series about the internet's biggest scammers and the people who fell for them.
items.proof: 53 million downloads. Number one on Apple Podcasts. Winner of the 2023 Ambie for Best Entertainment Podcast, with a second nomination in 2025.

items.title: Dying for Sex
items.role: Co-developer and producer of the original podcast
items.summary: A narrative series about Molly Kochan leaving her marriage after a terminal cancer diagnosis and telling the story to her best friend, Nikki Boyer.
items.proof: Winner of the 2021 Ambie for Podcast of the Year. The FX television adaptation won a Peabody Award, received nine Emmy nominations, and received a 2026 Television Academy Honor.

items.title: The Last City
items.summary: An immersive 12-part science-fiction thriller starring Rhea Seehorn, set inside a utopian society surviving the climate crisis.
items.proof: Number one in Apple Fiction in 20 countries. Nominated for the 2025 Ambie for Best Fiction Podcast.

items.title: Born This Way
items.summary: A documentary series following seven young adults with Down syndrome as they build careers, independence, and relationships.
items.proof: Three Primetime Emmy wins and 16 nominations.

items.title: No Passport Required
items.organization: Vox Media, PBS, and Apple TV
items.summary: Chef Marcus Samuelsson travels the United States to explore immigrant communities redefining American food.
items.proof: Winner of a James Beard Media Award.

items.title: Hollywood & Crime
items.summary: Two seasons inside Wondery's Hollywood true-crime anthology, including Billionaire Boys Club and The Execution of Bonny Lee Bakley.

items.title: Life of Kylie
items.summary: A documentary series following Kylie Jenner at the height of the Kardashian-Jenner media empire.

chapters.title: Ghost Mode Labs
chapters.description: Original IP, research systems, and working prototypes exploring how stories can be researched, built, and extended.

items.title: Visual Audiobooks
items.summary: Original children's stories whose visual world can change each time a listener returns.

items.title: Static
items.summary: A scripted supernatural series built from online folklore, developed with a research tool that finds recurring story patterns across public archives.

items.title: Multiverse Quad
items.summary: A working demonstration of one story unfolding across an animated film, graphic novel, visual audiobook, and podcast.

items.title: AI Creator Lab
items.summary: Wondery's first AI Creator Lab, a practical program for testing emerging tools inside real production workflows. Participation grew from four people to more than fifty across the company.

items.title: Narrative Space
items.summary: A working prototype that turns story notes, characters, timelines, and locations into a three-dimensional space writers can explore.

items.title: Unstill
items.summary: A proposal that uses archival records, color, motion, and changing inscriptions to reconsider lives preserved in 1920s Sydney police photographs.

items.title: MythOS
items.summary: A research prototype that maps 3,500 years of mythology and folklore across cultures to help development teams find public-domain story material.
items.proof: The working prototype contains 494 source stories.
